units.source_en: At that, my aunt finally smiled.”
units.source_zh: 说到这里，姑母终于笑了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康这么一问，万千代奕奕有神的眼睛望着摇曳的烛光，道：“我说氏真现在是姑父的仇人，为保家族平安，也应归顺大人。说到这里，姑母终于笑了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What did she say?”

units.source_en: “What did she say?”
units.source_zh: “她说什么？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “她说什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: “She said I was still a child and understood nothing of matters between grown people... When I pressed her further, she finally wept and said that if she surrendered, you would laugh at her...”

units.source_en: “She said I was still a child and understood nothing of matters between grown people... When I pressed her further, she finally wept and said that if she surrendered, you would laugh at her...”
units.source_zh: “她说我还是个孩子，不懂大人之间的事……我再说下去时，她终于流泪了，说，如果她投降，您会嘲笑她……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “她说我还是个孩子，不懂大人之间的事……我再说下去时，她终于流泪了，说，如果她投降，您会嘲笑她……”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu suddenly came to himself and saw that Manchiyo’s face was already streaming with tears.

units.source_en: Ieyasu suddenly came to himself and saw that Manchiyo’s face was already streaming with tears.
units.source_zh: 家康蓦然醒过神来，发现万千代早已潸然泪下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康蓦然醒过神来，发现万千代早已潸然泪下。

paragraphs.source_en: “My aunt once said that she loved you.”

units.source_en: “My aunt once said that she loved you.”
units.source_zh: “姑母曾说她喜欢您。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “姑母曾说她喜欢您。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I see.”

units.source_en: “I see.”

paragraphs.source_en: “She had thought she could rely on Lord Yoshimoto and live out her days in peace, but later found that she could not. The rise and fall of houses changes people’s destinies; just as rain is rain, yet spring rain and winter rain are not the same.”

units.source_en: “She had thought she could rely on Lord Yoshimoto and live out her days in peace, but later found that she could not.

paragraphs.source_en: “I see.”

units.source_en: “I see.”

paragraphs.source_en: “She said the colder and harsher the winter rain, the better. Rather than submit to you now and become a mild spring rain, she would sooner turn into freezing rain and snow. That way, she could remain longer in your heart...”

paragraphs.source_en: “I understand. You need say no more.”

units.source_en: “I understand. You need say no more.”
units.source_zh: “我知道了，你不必再说。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我知道了，你不必再说。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Please give me one hundred ashigaru. Since my aunt refuses to surrender the castle under any circumstances, I shall attack Hikimano myself.”

units.source_en: “Please give me one hundred ashigaru.
units.source_zh: “请给我一百足轻武士。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu did not answer. Was there still any need for that?

paragraphs.source_en: “Heihachi appears to have returned.” Sakuza, who had seemed to be asleep, suddenly raised his head. “My lord, Honda Heihachirō has returned. Will you have him killed?”

units.source_en: Sakuza, who had seemed to be asleep, suddenly raised his head. “My lord, Honda Heihachirō has returned.
units.source_zh: 看上去已睡着的作左突然抬起头，“主公，本多平八郎回来了。

units.source_zh: 您要杀了他？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “平八好像回来了。”看上去已睡着的作左突然抬起头，“主公，本多平八郎回来了。您要杀了他？”

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu still did not answer. In the wavering lamplight, his eyes rested gently closed, and he looked for all the world like a statue.

units.source_zh: 家康还是没有回答。
